title: Domain recovery under vague limits: a vague limit of admissible members μ₀^{x_i,λ_i} (μ₀ finite) whose domains all fail to contain a compact K is an admissible member whose domain also fails to contain K (parent step 5c)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and μ₀ a measure on ℝ^P with μ₀(ℝ^P) ≠ ∞. For x ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0 write μ₀^{x,λ} := ofReal(λ⁻¹^n)•μ₀.map(dilation x λ) and G_{x,λ} := dilation x λ '' B_2(0); call (x, λ) admissible if 0 < λ ≤ 1 and ‖x‖ ≤ 1 − λ. Let (x_i, λ_i) (i ∈ ℕ) be admissible, let ν be a measure on ℝ^P with ν(K') ≠ ∞ for every compact K', such that ∫ f dμ₀^{x_i,λ_i} → ∫ f dν for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ, and let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact with K ⊄ G_{x_i,λ_i} for every i. Then there is an admissible (x, λ) with ν = μ₀^{x,λ} and K ⊄ G_{x,λ}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ₀ : Measure (Euclid P)), μ₀ univ ≠ ∞ → ∀ (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (K : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ i, 0 < lams i ∧ lams i ≤ 1 ∧ ‖xs i‖ ≤ 1 - lams i) → (∀ K' : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K' → ν K' ≠ ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun i => ∫ x, f x ∂(ENNReal.ofReal ((lams i)⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation (xs i) (lams i)))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂ν))) → IsCompact K → (∀ i, ¬ K ⊆ dilation (xs i) (lams i) '' ball 0 2) → ∃ (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), (0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ 1 - lam) ∧ ν = (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam)) ∧ ¬ K ⊆ dilation x lam '' ball 0 2
